name: Screen/Create Server — Step 3 Configure (Reserve less on)

children.name: Changing location help
children.text: Changing cluster starts a fresh draft. The chosen cluster handles all creation steps.

children.name: Field Server name
texts: Used as pod name and subdomain. Lowercase, dash-separated.

children.name: Field Description
texts: Hardcore survival realm with curated mods. Invite only.

children.name: Helper
children.text: Only the reserved amount counts when the server is placed on a node, so more servers fit; it can use more, up to the limit, when the node has room (Burstable QoS).

children.name: Helper
children.text: Picks node with most free memory, tolerations or no taints.

children.name: Field MOTD
texts: Server description shown in the multiplayer list.

children.name: Field World seed
texts: Leave blank for a random seed.

children.name: Field Online mode
texts: Verify players with Mojang. Disable only for offline/LAN setups.

children.name: Field JVM max heap
texts: Java heap ceiling (-Xmx, e.g. 2G, 3072M). Leave empty to size it automatically to 75% of the container memory limit — it then tracks the limit whenever you resize the server. If you set it yourself, keep roughly 25% below the limit: the JVM needs headroom for non-heap memory, and exceeding the limit gets the server OOM-killed.

children.name: Field JVM initial heap
texts: Starting heap size (-Xms), at most JVM max heap. Leave empty to match the automatic max heap (a fixed heap avoids GC resizes).

children.name: TipText
children.text: Memory tip — factor in mod/plugin overhead; Minecraft Vanilla uses ~1.5 GB at 4 players.
